normal: Gray fabric with a soft, slightly blurred texture of long diagonal streaks in light and dark gray, running evenly across the whole image; fine grain and gentle shading changes are part of this texture; no spots or marks.
defective: Gray fabric where the texture differs from smooth even diagonal streaks: the whole surface looks rougher, coarser, mottled or clumpy, or there is a small spot, speck or foreign mark.
